records.character_source: Broly; Broly (Full Power Super Saiyan); Kefla (Super Saiyan) Customize Partner

records.name: Energy Jet
records.effect: Large purple Ki ball launched for a multi-hit attack.

records.name: Zetsumei Bullet
records.effect: Close-range grab ending with Cell's tail thrust and Ki wave.

records.name: Self-Destruct
records.effect: Grab-based self-destruction that kills both user and target on connection.

records.name: Cookie Beam
records.effect: Turns the opponent into a cookie; Buu eats the cookie and restores health.

records.name: Appetizing Rush
records.effect: Teleporting rush attack ending in Savory Slicer.

records.name: Pretty Charge
records.effect: Ki-charge Super with a unique Ribrianne pose; functions similarly to Full Power Charge.

records.name: Divinity Unleashed
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 110: Heretics from a Dark World
records.effect: Charges Ki; after one Ki bar is charged, grants a temporary buff that increases Ki gained from attacks and accelerates charging.

notes: Dedicated Xenoverse 2 pages are preferred over older guides when metadata conflicts. Gigantic Omega was absent from canonical skills.json and has explicit dedicated-page taxonomy and cost evidence. Added five cast-exclusive Ultimate records with dedicated taxonomy evidence: Energy Jet, Zetsumei Bullet, Self-Destruct, Cookie Beam, and Appetizing Rush. Added Pretty Charge and Divinity Unleashed after dedicated pages confirmed their Super subcategories and availability.
